# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
# above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a stage's section when the stage first draws with its
# shaders, so that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's
# docs/porting.md, Prebuilt shader lists).
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing: bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's
# tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each section. Section 0 is the
# launcher, the boot (the N64 logo, the opening and the title) and the main menu, reached with Start as a player does.
# The menus' section goes on with the stick and A to VS Mode and its character select, then tools/shader_survey.js
# starts each other menu as the menus do (stage select, the 1P menu and its three character selects, Training's,
# Options, Data, Characters, VS Record and Sound Test). Then a section a VS stage, its battle started from character
# select as stage select does (tools/shader_survey.js's vs()): four computer players, the twelve fighters three times
# over the nine stages, 40 s of the game's time with items, then the clock run out and the results. Then a section for
# each of the 1P Game's own stages, started from its stage as its character select does (spgame(): Metal Mario's Meta
# Crystal, Race to the Finish, the Fighting Polygon Team's Duel Zone and Master Hand's Final Destination), its intro
# and 40 s of its battle, port 1 standing still; and one for each fighter's Bonus Practice 1 (Break the Targets) and 2
# (Board the Platforms) as its character select starts it (bonus()), 20 s, the fighter standing still (some fall off,
# which ends the stage). Not recorded: the 1P Game's teams and giants on the VS stages, its continue, game over,
# ending and credits, a target broken or a platform boarded, Training Mode's own screens, team battles, Sudden Death,
# the challenger and unlock screens, and the How to Play movie. Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA,
# upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording again.
#
# The boot's last two are a VS battle's that a play of Peach's Castle with items missed after the recording, added by
# hand to the boot so that every stage has them.
